$comment: What each /api/chat/* route answers (docs/API.md, docs/REFACTOR.md item 54), as JSON Schema (the subset tests/support/schema.ts checks: type, enum, const, pattern, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, minItems, maxItems, anyOf, $ref to #/$defs). Every 2xx JSON answer the integration tests get is checked against its route's schema (tests/integration/helpers.ts); tests/unit/answers.test.ts checks the examples against the schemas and that every route the server defines is here; the app's ContractTest.kt decodes the examples with its models. A route's answer changes here first: adding a field to a record or an answer fails the integration tests until it is listed.

time.$comment: PocketBase's date format, UTC; empty for none.

profile.$comment: Someone as the routes that aren't the records API show them (no email).

userRecord.$comment: A users record (records API rules apply: email only to its owner). fields.user and the expands of messages and rooms ask for some of these.

message.$comment: A messages record, with the fields asked for (fields.message, fields.activity) or all of them. A message of an anonymous room reads with author = the room's id to anyone but its author. JSON fields never set (a message relayed from another server, an old one) read as null: clients treat null as empty.

room.$comment: A rooms record, with the fields asked for (fields.room) or all of them.

exportFile.$comment: The file GET /api/chat/export/file downloads (DESIGN.md §43.2). Checked by tests/integration/account_delete.test.ts, not by the answers check (it is a download).

invite.$comment: A private room's invite link (pb_hooks/lib/invites.js answer, DESIGN.md §44.1): its token (the link is /invite/<token>), when it was made and stops working, and how many people it added; null when the room has none that works.

GET /api/chat/rooms/{room}/messages.$comment: A page of a room, or search results (server/lists.go). 304 with no body for an unchanged page.

GET /api/chat/notifiable.$comment: What the app's periodic check notifies of (server/lists.go).

GET /api/chat/live.$comment: The realtime topic of live messages (server/live.go); 404 on a server from before it.

GET /api/chat/unread.$comment: Unread counts by room, the rooms with an unread message counted by id only (ids), the inbox's count, who its newest rows are from (inbox_from: at most 3, newest first; since 2026-11-23) and mentions by room (server/unread.go).

GET /api/chat/unread/{room}.$comment: The oldest unread message of a room; both empty when there is none.

POST /api/chat/reads.$comment: Your read position in a room, after the mark (server/reads.go).

POST /api/chat/dms.$comment: The DM with someone, made if there was none (pb_hooks/lib/dms.js).

GET /api/chat/users.$comment: People found by name or handle (pb_hooks/lib/users.js).

POST /api/chat/remote-users.$comment: Someone on a linked server, by address (pb_hooks/federation/inbox.js); 404 with federation off.

GET /api/chat/mentionable.$comment: Whom the composer offers after an @ (pb_hooks/lib/handles.js).

GET /api/chat/inbox.$comment: A page of Mentions & replies, newest first (pb_hooks/lib/inbox.js); `cursor` asks for the next.

POST /api/chat/reactions.$comment: The message after the reaction (pb_hooks/lib/reactions.js), with the fields asked for.

POST /api/chat/forward.$comment: The copies made in the room forwarded to (pb_hooks/lib/bulk.js).

POST /api/chat/ban.$comment: The account after the change (pb_hooks/lib/moderation.js); moderators only.

POST /api/chat/password.$comment: A new session after the change (pb_hooks/lib/account.js): the other sessions end.

GET /api/chat/export.$comment: Where your newest export is (pb_hooks/lib/account.js exportStatus, DESIGN.md §43.2): "none" (never asked, or gone after 7 days), "queued" (the worker is making it), "done" (GET /api/chat/export/file downloads it until `expires`) or "failed". POST asks for one and answers the same.

POST /api/chat/export.$comment: Where your newest export is (pb_hooks/lib/account.js exportStatus, DESIGN.md §43.2): "none" (never asked, or gone after 7 days), "queued" (the worker is making it), "done" (GET /api/chat/export/file downloads it until `expires`) or "failed". POST asks for one and answers the same.

GET /api/chat/rooms/{room}/invite.$comment: The room's invite link, for its creator or a moderator in it (DESIGN.md §44.1); null for none, or once the room isn't private. DELETE revokes it (204).

POST /api/chat/rooms/{room}/invite.$comment: A new invite link for the private room ({ days: 1 | 7 | 30 }, 7 when not given), replacing its last one (DESIGN.md §44.1).

GET /api/chat/invites/{token}.$comment: Where an invite link goes, for anyone who has it (guests too; DESIGN.md §44.2): the room, how many members it has, who made the link, until when it works, and whether you are in already. 404 when it doesn't work.

POST /api/chat/invites/{token}.$comment: Join the room by its invite link, signed in (DESIGN.md §44.2): you are one of its members now (or were already). 404 when the link doesn't work, 400 when the room is full.

GET /api/chat/media/{room}.$comment: A page of a room's images and videos, newest first (pb_hooks/lib/media.js).

GET /api/chat/collections.$comment: Your collections and those you follow, by name (pb_hooks/lib/collections.js).

GET /api/chat/badges.$comment: What the badge of a file attached from each collection may say; null for one that is gone (pb_hooks/lib/collections.js).

POST /api/chat/items.$comment: The item saved to a collection (pb_hooks/lib/collections.js).

GET /api/chat/saved.$comment: The collections a file is saved in already: collection → item.

GET /api/chat/stats.$comment: Usage counts for moderators and superusers (pb_hooks/lib/stats.js); the web's /stats page only. samples: [ms, online, guests, web, android].

GET /api/chat/metrics.$comment: Superusers only (server/metrics.go); the web's /stats page shows it. Prometheus text with ?format=prometheus instead.
